channel.title: 1000 Errors: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures
channel.description: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Platonic Energy Circle, LED Sacred Geometry Wall Mandala
item.description: Platonic Energy Circle light sculpture glowing turquoise, with a thumbs-up. Three-layer laser cut birch wall mandala featuring the five platonic solids, with colour-changing LED lighting. 60cm or 89cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Quintessence LED Light Sculpture, 5-Layer Wood Mandala
item.description: Side view of the Quintessence light sculpture on its wooden stand. Five-fold sacred geometry light sculpture in 5 layers of laser cut wood, with colour-changing LEDs and a stand. Numbered first run. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Seed of Life LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Birch Mandala
item.description: Seed of Life laser cut wooden light sculpture glowing purple on its stand. Seed of Life sacred geometry light sculpture, laser cut from layered birch and hand painted, with adjustable LED lighting. 30–80cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Septagram LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Wood Mandala
item.description: Septagram laser cut wooden LED light sculpture glowing green on its stand. Seven-pointed septagram light sculpture in 7 layers of laser cut wood, LED-lit, with a stand and wall hanging ring. 30–80cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Squircles: 3D Printed Shadow Lamp Design
item.description: Simulated shadows from the lamp covering the walls, floor and ceiling of a room. Squircles, a standalone app for designing 3D printed lamps that cast patterned shadows, which began as a Blender add-on. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Layered Laser Cut Beetle Art
item.description: 3D preview of the beetle sunk into a tunnel of rainbow coloured layers. Building an app to add three-dimensional depth to beetle paintings with stacked, laser cut layers of card. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Sacred Geometry Laser Cut Light Art
item.description: A hexagonal sacred geometry mandala in layered laser cut wood, held up outdoors. Sacred geometry light art, laser cut from layered wood and illuminated with LEDs. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.
